title: Elytra Backtank
description: For a mod called "Create Fly", there's surprisingly little flight. Let's fix that.
body:
This mod adds an elytra backtank to the Create mod.

Features:

- Craft the elytra backtank with an elytra and a netherite backtank. (waow)
- Use the air in the backtank to boost.
- No durability; fly until you run out of fuel
- Also adds a speedometer so that you can see whether you can reach ignition speed.
